metrics_finding.finding: order-service CPU utilization increased from baseline to failure, while memory utilization decreased and mean latency increased.

evidence_summary.summary: Order service CPU utilization increased, while memory utilization decreased and mean latency increased.

report.suggested_fix: Investigate and optimize order-service for CPU utilization and memory usage.

report_text.en: The root cause of the incident is believed to be related to the order service. Further investigation is required to confirm this.
